kid: The phone line carried the internet and phone calls at the same time, as tones too high to hear. A box with a modem inside sent Wi‑Fi to every room.
nerd: DSL: ADSL2+ and then VDSL2 from street cabinets, from a few to tens of Mbit/s on the copper pair. A modem-router at home does NAT and 802.11n Wi‑Fi.

describe.kid: A box with one antenna and two little lights. Wavy tones come out of its side: the modem inside sings down the phone line.
describe.nerd: A DSL modem-router: one Wi‑Fi antenna, status lights, and DMT tones leaving its phone socket.
